verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a federal data and registration portal, and AI-generated insights over its data are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only search parameters, filtering, and JSON/CSV data retrieval via APIs. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
